labels.note: Mostly reconstructs input, but query/hash-only inputs like "?a=b" or "#x" gain a leading "/".
A query with several '?' loses the extra ones: "/foo/?a?b" becomes "/foo?ab".
A query with several '?' loses the extra ones: "/foo?a?b" becomes "/foo/?ab".
withBase("/foo?x=1","/foo") adds the base twice, giving "/foo/foo?x=1".
nextChar is never "", so this acts like dropping the '?' check; the base gets duplicated.
Only differs when base is empty and input starts with "//": slashes collapse to one.
Same as the previous item: only an empty base with a "//x" input changes the result.
When the rest starts with '?', the first slash inside the query is removed and the query is corrupted.
